request.text:
Employee ticket:
A visitor is coming to the Lahore office tomorrow. How do they get on the guest Wi-Fi?

Knowledge base:
[1] Guest Wi-Fi in the Lahore office · Steps
## Steps
The Lahore office has no reception desk. Visitors join NW-Guest-LHE and the hosting employee requests a guest code from the IT channel in Teams; the code lasts for the length of the visit. The NW-Guest one-day codes do not work in Lahore.

[2] Guest Wi-Fi for visitors · Steps
## Steps
Visitors join the NW-Guest network and sign in with a one-day code that reception prints from the visitor system. Codes expire at midnight. Employees never share their own corporate Wi-Fi certificate with visitors.

[3] Lahore office network and power backup · Notes
## Notes
During scheduled power load-shedding, the Lahore office runs on generator power and the main switch restarts once. Wi-Fi returns within two minutes. If the VPN drops at the same time, reconnect after the Wi-Fi is back rather than resetting the profile.

1. Have the visitor join the NW-Guest-LHE network.
2. Request a guest code from the IT channel in Teams; the code lasts for the length of the visit
